title: Mesmer armor
wikitext: {{TOCright}} A full set of [[Mesmer]] armor consists of a mask, attire, gloves, hose and footwear. ==Armor bonuses== [[Basic armor|Basic]] Mesmer armor provides up to a maximum of 60 [[Armor rating|armor]], 10 extra [[energy]] and 2 extra [[energy recovery]].
